values.meaning: duration stones remain on the ground
values.quote: The stones then remain for 4 seconds and {{tip|slow}} enemies within the area by 20%.

values.meaning: slow percent within the stone field
values.quote: slow}} enemies within the area by 20%
becoming {{tip|stun|stunned}} for {{fd|0.75}} seconds, increased to 2 seconds if they are a {{tip|monster}}

values.meaning: damage reduction per additional stone detonated (up to 4)
values.quote: the damage is reduced by {{pp|changedisplay=true|key=%|type=stones detonated|0 to 75 for 4}}
values.binNote: Bin stores the falloff as a fraction per stack (0.25), i.e. damage multiplier per Nth detonation is 1-0.25*(N-1); wiki states the cumulative reduction percentages 0/25/50/75 directly, which are 0.25*(N-1)*100 for N=1..4 - consistent, not a genuine disagreement, just a different representation.

values.meaning: delay between cascading rows of stones
values.quote: The stones spawn in rows that cascade in {{fd|0.17}} second intervals.

mechanics.claim: Unraveled Earth deals damage to enemies hit while the stones erupt, i.e. on cast/scatter, separate from detonation damage.
mechanics.quote: scatters a field of 22 stones across the ground in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit while they erupt

mechanics.claim: A dashing or knocked-up enemy detonates a stone, dealing separate detonation damage and stunning once the displacement ends.
mechanics.quote: Enemies that {{tip|dash}} or are {{tip|airborne|knocked}} over a stone will detonate it, taking {{as|magic damage}} and becoming {{tip|stun|stunned}} for {{fd|0.75}} seconds ... The stun is applied once the displacement ends.

mechanics.claim: Monster detonation stun is increased to 2 seconds, and the mine damage falloff means up to 4 detonations per cast per enemy with reduced damage each stack.
mechanics.quote: An enemy can detonate up to 4 stones, but the damage is reduced by {{pp|changedisplay=true|key=%|type=stones detonated|0 to 75 for 4}}

mechanics.claim: Unraveled Earth can only apply its effects to a given target once per cast; further stone contact still detonates the stone visually but has no effect.
mechanics.quote: ''Unraveled Earth'' can affect targets only once per cast; the stones will still detonate but not apply their effects.

mechanics.claim: Unraveled Earth fires in 6 cascading rows, first with 2 stones and the rest with 4 each, over the cast.
mechanics.quote: ''Unraveled Earth'' fires 6 rows of stones: the first row has 2 stones, and the rest have 4 each.

mechanics.claim: The ability will not detonate if the target is untargetable while dashing over the stones, or if they blink onto the stones.
mechanics.quote: ''Unraveled Earth'' will not detonate if the target dashes over the stones while being untargetable. ... will not detonate against enemies that blink onto the stones.
